title: Tibetan Music Preservation | Traditional and Classical Music
text: Tibetan Music Preservation (TMP) is an online initiative to preserve and promote endangered Tibetan traditional music. TMP projects include audio and video recordings of traditional and classical music, interviews of traditional artists. These online archives are free of charge for the public to access.
